Proposition
[Existence of Smooth Exhaustion Functions]

1. ch2:2.28Every smooth manifold with or without boundary admits a positive smooth exhaustion function.

Proof

\sketch Choose a countable cover by precompact open sets $V_j$ and a subordinate partition $\psi _j$. Set $f=\sum _{j\geq 1}j\psi _j$. Local finiteness gives smoothness and $f\geq 1$. For $N>c$, outside $\bigcup _{j=1}^N\overline V_j$ one has $f\geq N>c$; hence $f^{-1}(( -\infty ,c])$ is closed in a finite union of compact closures and is compact.

□
